parsedVerdict.reasoning: The module has one concern: infrastructure adapters for the task service. Each file plays one role. src/infrastructure/in-memory-repositories.ts is the storage adapter: it implements the domain repository interfaces with no extra logic. src/infrastructure/http-app.ts is the HTTP adapter: it parses requests, maps errors to status codes and shapes responses. It also holds the composition root, createTaskService, which wires the in-memory repositories into TaskService. src/infrastructure/server.ts is only the process entry point. Each invariant lives in one place. Filter matching is only in InMemoryTaskRepository.findByProjectId. Request parsing goes through readText, asObject, readQuery and readParam. The error-to-status mapping is in a single error middleware. Response serialization is only in toTaskResponse. Two small points don't amount to a failure. First, the GET /projects/:projectId/tasks handler reads req.params.projectId directly instead of using readParam. Second, the shared complete handler has its own typeof check on projectId. Both are local, minor inconsistencies, not a systematic bypass or a duplicated business rule. Keeping the composition root in http-app.ts is a reasonable infrastructure choice and doesn't split the module into unrelated concerns.
